items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Adds Restricted Pharmacy Path For New Myeloma Drug

ZENBEXUS, a newly approved therapy for certain multiple myeloma patients, will be dispensed through a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy program.
